from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
data = main / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data'
for name, expected in (
    ('predicates.json', '8271f1d000a73808f1fa9787b90e868dd99038098eab192b26372e4eeaf694f6'),
    ('measurement_exemptions.json', '4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945'),
):

    print(name + ' canonical=' + actual)
